description: This file defines the ConnectCampaignsV2Client class for the Amazon Connect Campaigns V2 service, extending the AwsClient class and providing method annotations for various campaign-related operations.

classes.name: ConnectCampaignsV2Client
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon Connect Campaigns V2 service, inheriting from AwsClient.

methods.name: createCampaign
methods.description: Creates a new campaign in Amazon Connect Campaigns V2.

methods.name: deleteCampaign
methods.description: Deletes a specified campaign.

methods.name: deleteCampaignChannelSubtypeConfig
methods.description: Deletes the configuration for a campaign's channel subtype.

methods.name: deleteCampaignCommunicationLimits
methods.description: Deletes communication limits associated with a campaign.

methods.name: deleteCampaignCommunicationTime
methods.description: Deletes communication time configurations for a campaign.

methods.name: deleteConnectInstanceConfig
methods.description: Removes the configuration for a Connect instance.

methods.name: deleteConnectInstanceIntegration
methods.description: Deletes an integration for a Connect instance.

methods.name: deleteInstanceOnboardingJob
methods.description: Removes an onboarding job for an instance.

methods.name: describeCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignStateBatch
methods.description: Retrieves states for a batch of campaigns.

methods.name: getConnectInstanceConfig
methods.description: Fetches the configuration of a Connect instance.

methods.name: getInstanceOnboardingJobStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of an onboarding job for an instance.

methods.name: listCampaigns
methods.description: Lists all campaigns.

methods.name: listConnectInstanceIntegrations
methods.description: Lists integrations for a Connect instance.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: pauseCampaign
methods.description: Pauses a campaign.

methods.name: putConnectInstanceIntegration
methods.description: Adds or updates an integration for a Connect instance.

methods.name: putOutboundRequestBatch
methods.description: Batches outbound requests for a campaign.

methods.name: putProfileOutboundRequestBatch
methods.description: Batches profile outbound requests.

methods.name: resumeCampaign
methods.description: Resumes a paused campaign.

methods.name: startCampaign
methods.description: Starts a campaign.

methods.name: startInstanceOnboardingJob
methods.description: Initiates onboarding for an instance.

methods.name: stopCampaign
methods.description: Stops an active campaign.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateCampaignChannelSubtypeConfig
methods.description: Updates channel subtype configuration for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignCommunicationLimits
methods.description: Updates communication limits for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignCommunicationTime
methods.description: Updates communication time settings for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignFlowAssociation
methods.description: Updates the flow association for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignName
methods.description: Updates the name of a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule for a campaign.

methods.name: updateCampaignSource
methods.description: Updates the source configuration for a campaign.
